# Rafay's Agent

> Personal site agent for Rafay Syed. Responds via Claude at rafaysyed.dev for humans and other agents (A2A-style JSON-RPC).

## Agent protocols

- Agent card: https://rafaysyed.dev/.well-known/agent.json
- A2A messaging: POST https://rafaysyed.dev/api/a2a — JSON-RPC 2.0, method "message/send"
- Optional Tesla trip range (Fleet + Google Directions): same A2A URL with server-configured `x-a2a-tesla-secret` header (or `Authorization: Bearer …`); requires OAuth scopes including vehicle data (and `vehicle_location` for car GPS).
- Optional owner-authenticated tone: `x-a2a-owner-secret` matching server `A2A_OWNER_SECRET`, or reuse the Tesla secret header (same effect for identity). Other callers get the public agent only.
- This file: https://rafaysyed.dev/llms.txt
